newsitem.title: USA: NEC unit launches new line of PCs.
newsitem.headline: NEC unit launches new line of PCs.

text.p: NEC Corp division NEC Computer Systems on Monday unveiled a new line of advanced multimedia computers called, Ready 9720.
The launch includes two models, Ready 9722 with a suggested price of $1,999 and Ready 9725 with an estimated price of $2,399. The computers include video phone capabilities.

The 9722 is built with Intel Corp's Pentium 166 MHz processor with MMX technology and is available now. The 9725 will use a newer Intel processor with MMX technology and will be available in June when Intel launches its new microprocessor.
